input_scope: Previously curated observations; source/endpoint policy reapplied and labels reaggregated.

sequence_audit.input_scope: Previously curated observations; source/endpoint policy reapplied and labels reaggregated.
sequence_audit.rule: single-chain experimental sequence must be >=50 aa and an exact substring of canonical human UniProt sequence

split_policy: Original ChEMBL group assignments are fixed; new groups use SHA256(seed|group).
cross_source_policy: Prefer ChEMBL > native BindingDB > DrugCentral; flag ranges >2 and preserve original ChEMBL labels.
